name: E02_8_crossway_troublemakers_deathtouch_lifelink_vampire_double_blocked
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Attacking Vampires you control have deathtouch and lifelink.' Seat 0's Vampire (2/2) attacks and seat 1's two 0/9 Walls both block it. With deathtouch any nonzero damage is lethal (CR 702.2c), so seat 0 may assign 1 damage to each Wall (CR 510.1c): both Walls die. Lifelink counts all damage dealt, 2: seat 0 gains 2 (22). Troublemakers stays home.
